title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Relation Extraction within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2406.14745v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Information Extraction (IE) plays a pivotal role in transforming unstructured data into structured formats, such as Knowledge Graphs. One of the main tasks within IE is Relation Extraction (RE), which identifies relations between entities in text data. This process enriches the semantic understanding of documents, enabling more precise information retrieval and query answering. Recent works leveraging pre-trained language models have demonstrated significant performance improvements in RE. In the current era of Large Language Models (LLMs), fine-tuning these LLMs can mitigate the limitations of zero-shot RE methods, particularly in overcoming the domain adaptation challenges inherent in RE. translated_title: 在检索增强生成框架中微调大语言模型进行关系抽取
translated_abstract: 信息抽取（IE）在将非结构化数据转换为知识图谱等结构化格式方面发挥着关键作用。信息抽取中的主要任务之一是关系抽取（RE），它识别文本数据中实体之间的关系。这一过程丰富了文档的语义理解，使得更精确的信息检索和查询回答成为可能。近期利用预训练语言模型的研究在关系抽取方面展现出了显著的性能提升。在大语言模型（LLM）时代，对这些大语言模型进行微调可以缓解零样本关系抽取方法的局限性，特别是在克服关系抽取中固有的领域适应挑战方面。本工作不仅探索了微调大语言模型的有效性，还探讨了将其集成到基于检索增强生成（RAG）的关系抽取方法中，以解决通用大语言模型作为生成器时所面临的领域适应挑战。
tldr: 本文提出在检索增强生成（RAG）框架中微调大语言模型以进行关系抽取，有效解决了通用大语言模型作为生成器时面临的领域适应挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes fine-tuning large language models for relation extraction within a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework, effectively addressing the domain adaptation challenges that arise when general-purpose LLMs serve as generators.
